# lamejs 1.2.1

This directory contains the unmodified `lame.all.js` source distribution of
[lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), by Alex Zhukov, from npm version 1.2.1.
It is used as a separate script for browser-side MP3 encoding.

lamejs is licensed under LGPL-3.0, separately from this application's MIT license.
The full readable JavaScript distribution is included so users can inspect and
replace the encoder. Original package and source:
https://registry.npmjs.org/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.1.tgz

LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
License: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html
See also the upstream author's license notes in UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt.
